name: Hoof and claw specialist
design: Short extremely broad older male Yautja, ochre-red mottled hide, high alien brow and four ivory mandibular arms with worn tips, thick salt-and-black tendrils neck length. Charcoal heavy leather bib apron over faded mustard tunic, riveted knee pads, soft calf wraps. Holds a broad blunt grooming file horizontally at waist in one hand and a folded grey cloth in the other; closed clipping tools on belt. No animal limb.
